verdict.rationale: stagewise documents agents with direct file read/write, shell command execution, and browser CDP access, but nothing about sandboxed or isolated execution for code, tools, or network. A community comment says it should be sandboxed by default and that running agents directly on the host is a bad idea, which suggests agents run on the host. Diff review and undo are post-hoc review controls, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
